title: Markup re-runs keep slice names stable
description:
As a composer, I want re-running analysis to never change what my scores play.

```gherkin
Feature: Stable slice names
  Scenario: Re-running markup keeps a slice's name and id
    Given a clip with ML slice "loop-1" spanning 10.0 to 14.0 seconds
    When markup proposes a loop spanning 10.1 to 14.0 seconds and a new loop spanning 30.0 to 34.0 seconds
    Then "loop-1" keeps its id and spans 10.1 to 14.0 seconds
    And the new loop gets a name that was never used on this clip

  Scenario: A slice a score uses is retired, not deleted
    Given score "chop-shop" uses slice "loop-2"
    When markup no longer proposes "loop-2"
    Then "loop-2" is marked retired and "chop-shop" still compiles
```
